merge_request_requires_manual_approval.description: When true, merge requests require human approval before merge; CLI may print reminders.

require_implementation_review_before_fin.description: When true, finish-this-task requires a human-approved implementation review in registry.yaml and work/implementation-summary-<NODE_ID>.md before closing the task.

require_implementation_before_finish.description: When true (default if omitted), finish-this-task refuses to close a node whose branch changes no file under its declared touch_zones. Skipped when the node declares no zones, or when git cannot compute the diff. CLI --allow-empty-implementation overrides it per run.

cleanup_work_artifacts_on_finish.description: When true (default if omitted), finish-this-task removes work/brief-, work/prompt-, and work/implementation-summary- for the node after validate/export.

on_complete.description: How finish-this-task lands work: pr = open a PR/MR (default); merge = merge feature branch into integration locally and push; auto = try merge+push first, then suggest PR/MR on failure.

track_worker_logs.description: Whether worker logs are tracked in git (default off when omitted). off (or YAML false) keeps them in gitignored work/.workers/ only; events also mirrors each worker's event log to work/worker-logs/<NODE_ID>/<worker id>.events.jsonl in the worker's checkout, which finish-this-task commits with the leaf; full mirrors the raw output log (<worker id>.log) too. Logs get long: full can add megabytes per leaf.

baseline_cmd.description: Shell command do-next-available-task and grind-session run on the integration branch, after syncing and before claiming a leaf (e.g. make test). A non-zero exit refuses the pickup, so a red base is fixed before a leaf inherits it. CLI --baseline-cmd wins (an empty value turns it off for that run); --baseline-warn downgrades a failure to a warning.

land_check_cmd.description: Shell command finish-this-task runs in merge (and auto) mode on the local merge commit, at the project root of a detached temporary worktree, before it pushes the integration branch (e.g. the full test and lint gate). A non-zero exit pushes nothing and resets the local integration branch. CLI --land-check-cmd wins (an empty value skips it for that run). pr mode never runs it.

prefer_agentic_pick_order.description: When true, do-next-available-task and grind-session order each pickup tier (Blocked, MR-rejected, the rest) Agentic-led, then Mixed, then unset, then Human-led, outline order within each (default false: outline order only). Eligibility is unchanged. CLI --prefer-agentic / --no-prefer-agentic wins.

grind_session_max_limit_waits.description: grind-session: how many times one leaf may wait out a Claude usage limit before the run stops (default 3). CLI --max-limit-waits wins.

grind_session_max_limit_wait_hours.description: grind-session: longest single wait for a stated Claude reset, in hours (default 6). A reset further out stops the run rather than waiting unattended. CLI --max-limit-wait-hours wins.

grind_session_limit_wait_grace_seconds.description: grind-session: slack added after the stated reset, because clocks disagree (default 120). CLI --limit-wait-grace-seconds wins.

grind_session_max_empty_retries.description: grind-session: how many times to re-run a Claude implement command that died on a signal without printing anything (default 2). Not a retry for failed implementations - those still stop the run. CLI --max-empty-retries wins.
